Organization policyPrinciple of Least Privilege: Users and systems should only have the minimum permissions needed to perform their jobs.Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Mandatory for all accounts, particularly administrative ones, to prevent unauthorized access from compromised credentials.Continuous Verification: A "Zero Trust" approach where every access attempt is verified regardless of its origin. 2. Access managementEncryption at Rest and in Transit: Sensitive data must be encrypted while stored (e.g., in databases) and while moving between systems (e.g., using TLS 1.3).Key Management: Securely store and rotate encryption keys, often using dedicated Key Management Services (KMS) or hardware security modules (HSM).Data Residency: Ensuring data is stored and processed in specific geographic regions to meet sovereignty requirements. 3. Tencent Cloud Security best practiceVirtual Private Clouds (VPC): Logically isolated sections of the cloud to control network traffic.Micro-segmentation: Dividing the network into smaller segments to limit "lateral movement" if a breach occurs.Web Application Firewalls (WAF): Protecting cloud applications from common web exploits. 4. Compliance and GovernanceRegulatory Alignment: Adherence to standards like GDPR (privacy), HIPAA (healthcare), and PCI DSS (payments).Security Frameworks: Using benchmarks such as ISO/IEC 27017 (cloud-specific security) or the NIST Cybersecurity Framework to guide policies.Regular Audits: Scheduled reviews of configurations and logs to detect "drift" from security baselines. 5. Threat detection & Risk AwarenessContinuous Monitoring: Real-time tracking of logs (e.g., using a SIEM system) to detect unusual activity like unauthorized API calls or mass downloads.Incident Response Playbook: A predefined plan for identifying, containing, and recovering from security breaches.Backup and Recovery: Regular, encrypted backups with a tested Disaster Recovery strategy to ensure business continuity

job_text: role: Software Engineer (Intern). work_mode: onsite. minimum_experience_years: 0.0. education: bachelor. skills: rest api, react.js, css, javascript, html, node.js. requirements: On-siteLess than a year of experienceMinimum Bachelors Degree. description: At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.Join Glints as a Software Engineer Intern and be part of our mission to help people and organizations realize their human potential. Youll work with experienced engineers on real-world products that power job matching, hiring, and talent development in Southeast Asia.Whether your focus is frontend, backend, or full-stack, youll build scalable solutions, learn agile development, and gain mentorship from Glints high-performance engineering team.A Pathway to Your Full-Time CareerPlease note: This program is designed as a direct launchpad for a full-time career at Glints. Our primary goal is to mentor and develop promising talent into long-term team members.Full-Time Conversion: While not guaranteed, this internship has a strong potential for a full-time (FT) offer. Conversion is based on your performance during the program and business needs at the time of completion.Eligibility: Because of this, the ideal candidate is a final-year university student or a recent graduate who is able to transition into a full-time role.Commitment & Location: This is a full-time role. While the on-site requirement for the internship is negotiable, we expect you to work from our office upon conversion to a full-time position.What You'll Be DoingIn this role, you will:- Collaborate with an agile development team to support the delivery of impactful web features and improvements.- Assist in building and testing web application features, primarily using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React or similar frameworks.- Support frontend development tasks such as fixing bugs, improving UI, or implementing small features under close guidance.- Participate in code reviews, and team discussions where you will learn industry best practices and coding standards.- Be mentored by team members and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow in technical confidence and capability.Why You Should Join Us- Collaboration: Youll be part of a supportive and diverse team, learning from experienced engineers while contributing to real projects in a collaborative environment.- Real-World Experience: You will be working on one of our biggest products by user base, which is currently one of the leading job marketplaces in Indonesia.- Multicultural Environment: Join a multicultural team with members from different countries. We value your unique background and fresh perspective.- Learning & Innovation: We encourage curiosity and creativity. Youll be supported to explore new ideas and grow your technical and problem-solving skills.- Meaningful Contribution: Your work will help improve a platform that positively impacts the careers of millions of young professionals across Southeast Asia.Who We Are Looking For Were looking for enthusiastic learners who are passionate about web development and eager to grow through hands-on experience. While we dont expect interns to be experts, we value a strong foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.- Web Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.- Frontend Development: Some experience in React and frameworks like Next.js, and a desire to learn how modern web applications are built.- APIs: Basic understanding of how web apps communicate with backend services using REST or GraphQL.- Version Control: Familiarity with Git for tracking code changes and collaborating with a team.- Responsive Design: Awareness of responsive design principles and the ability to create layouts that work across devices.- Performance Awareness: Interest in learning how to make websites fast and efficient.- Security Awareness: Open to learning best practices for keeping web applications secure.Soft Skills- Problem-Solving: A logical mindset and curiosity to debug and figure things out.- Communication: Ability to ask good questions, explain what you're working on, and share progress or blockers clearly.- Team Collaboration: Willingness to work closely with peers and mentors, and to contribute to a supportive team environment.- Adaptability: Comfortable learning new tools, frameworks, and adapting to feedback.- Attention to Detail: Care in writing clean, working code and testing what you build.- Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for improving your skills and keeping up with web development trends.- Agile Mindset: Willingness to work in an iterative process, take part in standups, and deliver work in small, valuable chunks.Let's Realize Human Potential.At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.We have impacted many lives but theres still plenty to be done. If youre ready to grow and make an impact, youve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. Today, Glints is the most well-funded and well-capitalized startup in the talent recruitment space in Southeast Asia, with over US$80M in total investments raised till date.Our tech-enabled approach to recruitment and career discovery connects more than 3 million candidates to their next dream opportunities. We have also supported more than 50,000 companies in finding top talent and doubling recruitment efficiency.Our agility and firm hold on our core purpose and values have allowed us to remain resilient and thrive through tumultuous times. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. That's why we created the Glints Culture Code: #RIIBCOH. It defines our values, is what guides our decisions and actions, and is what makes us special.#RIIBCOH:1. Relentlessly Resourceful: Whatever it takes, just make it happen (ethically)2. Integrity: Have courage, be guided by the truth, dont be afraid 3. Impact: Missionaries, not mercenaries4. Beginners Mindset: Stay humble, dont be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.
